t.1.22.1: Sūta said: Thus praised then by Kadrū, the blessed lord Harivāhana covered the whole sky with masses of dark blue clouds.
t.1.22.2: Those clouds, blazing with lightning, released abundant water, roaring incessantly and exceedingly in the sky as if at one another.
t.1.22.3: The sky seemed as though packed solid with exceedingly wondrous clouds, which, with tremendous roars, poured forth incessantly an incomparable flood of water.
t.1.22.4: The sky seemed to dance with the countless waves of falling torrents, and the heavens became filled with the roaring thunder of the clouds.
t.1.22.5: Then, as Vāsava rained, the nāgas felt the greatest joy, and the earth too was filled with water on every side.
